description: Experience San Diego’s golden hour aboard a cozy, all‑electric Duffy boat on this intimate shared sunset cruise. With room for up to six guests (10 on Private Cruises), the quiet electric motor offers a smooth ride and panoramic views of Mission Bay, waterfront homes, and local wildlife. Settle into plush seating, stream your favorite music through the Bluetooth speaker, and enjoy photo opportunities as the sky turns pink and gold. The relaxed atmosphere suits couples, friends, solo travelers, and anyone after a peaceful evening on the water.

disclaimers:
Cruises last 60–90 minutes, depending on schedule and sunset timing. Operations may run in light wind and light rain; if conditions are unsafe, the operator will reschedule or refund. Private charters are available for up to six guests. Dynamic pricing may apply.

**⚠️ Minimum Guest Requirement Notice**
To operate this activity, we require a minimum of 3 total guests booked. These guests do not need to be part of the same group — all bookings for the date and time count toward the minimum.
If the activity does not reach at least 3 paid tickets, Keener Adventures will offer one of the following options:
- Reschedule to another available date or time
- Upgrade to a Private Cruise for that day at the private‑rate price
- Receive a credit that can be used toward any future Keener Adventures activity

We will notify all booked guests in advance if the minimum is not met.

faq_items.question: How long is the cruise?
faq_items.answer: Most sunset cruises run 60–90 minutes, depending on the time of year and sunset timing.

faq_items.question: Can I bring my own drinks or snacks?
faq_items.answer:
Only on Private Cruises—BYO beverages and light snacks are welcome; mocktail packages are available for purchase.

For ticketed cruises (Public Cruises), we ask that all items be purchased onboard.

faq_items.question: Is this cruise kid‑friendly?
faq_items.answer: Yes—children are welcome, but every passenger counts toward the six‑person capacity.

faq_items.question: Is the boat covered?
faq_items.answer: Yes—the Duffy has a full canopy and clear side panels that can be opened or closed depending on weather.

faq_items.question: What should I wear?
faq_items.answer: Evenings on the water can be cooler than on land; layers or a light jacket are recommended.

faq_items.question: Where do we meet?
faq_items.answer: Your confirmation email includes exact marina directions, parking information, and check‑in instructions.

faq_items.question: What if the weather is bad?
faq_items.answer: The operator runs in light wind and light rain; if conditions are unsafe they will reschedule or refund.

faq_items.question: Can I book the whole boat privately?
faq_items.answer: Yes—private charters are available for groups up to ten guests.
